note: What a server sends to put a unit on the field from the place its side sends them out of. It arrives on its own and also inside EnterSight. The header names the unit this is about.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The name the unit answers to, so later messages can name it.

fields.name: node
fields.note: Which network node the unit belongs to, in a field of its own rather than as part of the name that follows.

fields.name: wave
fields.note: Which run of units it belongs to.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of unit it is, from 0 to 3; a client spawns nothing for any other value.

fields.name: damageBonus
fields.note: What is added to the damage it deals.

fields.name: healthBonus
fields.note: What is added to the health it holds.
